description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldBool, which extends SugarFieldBase. The class provides methods for rendering search views, sanitizing import values, retrieving email template values, and unformatting fields specifically for boolean data types within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: SugarFieldBool
classes.description: Represents a boolean field in SuiteCRM, providing methods to handle display and data sanitization specific to boolean values.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the HTML for search view widgets, rendering either a dropdown or a checkbox based on field name patterns.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts various representations of boolean values into a standardized format suitable for database storage.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Provides a display value for boolean fields within email templates, returning labels for true or false as per app list strings.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts formatted boolean string representations into native boolean type.
